showList.label: Show the file list by default
showList.help: Lists the archive's files and folders in a sidebar when it opens. Changes apply immediately.

sort.label: Sort entries by
sort.help: How the list orders files and folders. The sidebar offers the same choice.

foldersFirst.label: Folders before files
foldersFirst.help: Keeps folders at the top of each level. Off, folders sort together with files.

wrap.label: Wrap long text lines
wrap.help: Off, a long line in a text entry scrolls sideways instead of folding.

textLimit.label: Text preview limit
textLimit.help: How much of a text entry is read for the preview. Larger files show their beginning only; the file list and the reported sizes are not affected.

mediaLimit.label: Image limit
mediaLimit.help: How much of an image entry is read to draw a preview. The file list and the reported sizes are not affected.

settings.label: 默认显示文件列表
settings.help: 打开压缩包时在侧栏列出内部文件与文件夹；修改立即生效。

settings.label: 列表排序方式
settings.help: 文件与文件夹的排列顺序。侧栏提供同一个选择。

settings.label: 文件夹排在前面
settings.help: 每一层先列文件夹。关闭后文件夹与文件一起排序。

settings.label: 文本自动换行
settings.help: 关闭后文本条目中的长行横向滚动，不折断。

settings.label: 文本预览上限
settings.help: 预览文本条目时最多读取多少内容；更大的文件只显示开头。文件列表与大小不受此项限制。

settings.label: 图片上限
settings.help: 预览图片条目时最多读取多少内容。文件列表与大小不受此项限制。
